title: Define generic score processor construct contract
description: Define a reusable infrastructure construct or construct interface for score processing that accepts externally owned queues, image references, configuration sources, concurrency settings, and optional alarms without embedding downstream deployment details.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Starting reusable construct implementation. The construct will be public-safe and parameterized: deployment owners provide naming prefix, environment name, ECR repository plus immutable tag/digest, runtime config secret mapping, concurrency settings, and optional extra IAM statements. It will not include downstream account IDs, queue names, pipeline names, or environment-specific deployment logic.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the public-safe AsyncScoreProcessing construct under infrastructure/plexus_constructs. It accepts deployment-owned naming, environment, ECR repository plus immutable tag/digest, runtime config secret mapping, optional existing queues, concurrency settings, Bedrock resources, and additional scoped IAM statements. Validation passed: python -m pytest infrastructure/tests/unit/test_async_score_processing_construct.py -q; python -m pytest tests/unit -q from infrastructure/score_processor_artifacts.
